before_notes: Activated by the owner-approved Gamma 601 F4 plan (delightful-foraging-quill, F4.6) under the linked parity plan to propose this row's status from committed Gamma 601 evidence; no device effect is authorized.
after_notes: The Gamma 601 seed (`board_default_seed_values("601")`) matches the pinned `config-601.cvs` in unit and golden tests: 525 MHz, 1150 mV, BM1370, the gamma device model and the 601's fan and self-test defaults. A factory install of the 601 package wrote the seed, and the board read its stored identity back from it (`built=601 stored=601 identity=match`); see docs/parity/evidence/20261022-gamma601-wifi-provisioning.md and docs/parity/work-plans/20261029T040600Z-CFG-002/RESULT.md. Verification needs a hardware readback of every seeded default, which the 601 build does not attest; the profiles the 601 mined with were saved by the harnesses, not read from the seed. Two differences from upstream remain: the factory install also saves mineonboot off, a key upstream lacks (ADR-0041 item 11), and the seed's selftest=1 does not start the self-test on first boot, which upstream does. Other Gamma boards remain non-claims.
